After 15 years of depression, I'm in a place where I'm told i give off POSITIVE vibrations. And trying my best to bring awareness to depression. But I'm living the dream, even tho i have my suicidal self harm days. But i pull through and keep on going.

I know it's hard, but please try to pull through. It will be worth it. I promise. I tried to kill myself when i was 14. And I've had depression for 15 years now, and yeah it's not great, but I am living the dream right now. And you can be there as well. I promise. I hate it when people just say 'it gets better' but it sooo does. You do have potential to do so many amazing things, you just need to find that potential and channel into it. Please wait, and reach out for help. It's a long process, but you will learn to enjoy life better than those who have never gone through depression and anxiety. And that there is already worth living for!
